_doc: Highest gate reached per task config, with evidence. Gates (AGENTS.md): -1 not built, 0 built in the harness, 1 inputs delivered and plausible (exact sources not required; docs/METHOD.md), 3 scoring sound and solvable, 4 shipped vs corrected compared, 5 policy-level. `gate` is cumulative over G0, G1, G3, G4 and G5 and is never 2: G2 (dynamics stress-tested) is recorded per task as the engine's known limits and is not required for higher gates (Bo, November 16, #199). `g2` holds that record: `status` pass, fail or open (null: never run), `evidence` (repo paths; empty when null) and `note`. G3 and above hold under one evaluator version, named in `notes` (an evaluator change is a new benchmark version; v1 is the shipped evaluator). `delivered` concerns the corrected physics path: true when asserting engine readbacks pass for every model the config spawns, false if one failed, null if unchecked or checked on only some models (`notes` give the coverage); the shipped path's non-delivery (#58) is recorded in `notes`. Update by PR with the evidence path; `python3 audit/tools/gates_table.py` checks the schema (tests: `audit/tools/test_gates_ledger.py`) and prints the STATUS table. Wound down on November 18, 2026 (#59; final summary docs/SUMMARY.md): verified means gate 3 or higher; every other config is excluded, with its reason in `notes` (G3 not run unless they say otherwise).

put_bottles_into_dustbin.notes: Corrected path delivered: asserting readbacks of all 10 bottle models, the bin and the camera stand pass at v2_presence (#186, #175); shipped path not delivered (#58, #5). G1 met: every outcome-relevant value is sourced, estimated or unsourced with a basis, and pad-PET friction and the empty masses were swept (#153). The gripper was run at the adverse corner of its docs/params ranges: efficiency 0.7 puts trip, stiffness and damping at their low ends (finger_trip_n 141.55 N), with finger_armature_kg 14.062 kg. There #160's witness loses steel bottle 00022 in the swing (nominal holds it; the force alone decides), and the held-out score is 18/20 under v2.2 (nominal 20/20 under v2, #186, which v2.2 does not change, #192; 2 flips, within seed noise; the corner is an adverse bound, not one consistent gripper; audit/out/bottles_grip_corner). The pad friction and mass sweeps ran before #163's gripper and at map v2b; #173 counts them. G3 met under evaluator v2.2 (#192): the shove (#109), closed fists (#177) and bottles on or beside the rim (#190) score 0, early return fails (#56), and the frozen script-bottles-v2 solves at corrected under v2.2 (6 corrected episodes rescored offline without a verdict change, #192; 20/20 held-out under v2, #186). v1 fails: the shove scores 25 or 40 and early return 100. Open, unwitnessed: a bottle resting on a jaw opened 20 mm or more. G4 met (#153: shipped 20/20 against corrected 18/20, one change at a time; corrected 20/20 at v2_presence, #186); it carries to v2.2: the script lifts every scored bottle over 0.17 m (#153) and holds at jaws of 48 mm or more (#192), so v2.1 and v2.2 change no verdict. G5 not met under v2.2: InternW0-Δ compared shipped and corrected only under v1 at map v1 (39/40 and 38/40) and ran shipped under v2.1 (38/40, #181), at seed 0 layouts 0 to 39 (#146); the corrected arm's 38/40 replaced layouts 6 and 37, rejected at reset, with 40 and 41 (counting those two as failures gives 36/40 on layouts 0 to 39); parked (Bo, November 16).
